Interesting article, if true, backs up my claim that soybean and canola oil and similar are utterly destroying people's immune systems. I fixed like 80% of my allergy and inflammation by cooking my food from scratch with nut oils and animal fat. Coconut!

1592406571723935744.a: My blood pressure was 165/110 for at least a decade. Hard to control. THe most significant change I made was to cut saturated fats from my diet and use primarily coconut oil. Beef tallow is amazing if you have a gold deposit. Grapeseed is great for high temp meat.BP is now 118/56

1592407120305324033.a: This means you literally cannot eat almost every single thing sold anywhere in the US. I did find a hack. I carry a bottle of Benadryl with me. If I absolutely must eat saturated fat I take a benadryl with it. That way my BP doesn't skyrocket.

1592408407583387649.a: Now, what led me to consider this? My grandmother had Lupus. Until she died I either ate her food or I made her food. I remember one time my mother made her dinner with soybean oil and it damned near killed her. Grandma was livid for days that my mother didn't buy Cottonseed oil.

1592408888544210944.a: Within 6 months of my grandmother dying my health imploded. I was in the ER, stuck in bed for months at a time, etc. My mother had started just bringing us fast food after work and not cooking. I had only eaten fast food as a treat or on the way home from school now and then.

1592409508466561024.a: I was able to get my blood pressure under control and work a little. So I began buying lunch at a little Chicago style deli one of the neighbors owned. Every meal because they had a variety of things. It was the only restaurant left within walking distance. Everything made fresh.

1592410394190307328.a: I felt absolutely great the entire time I did that. Then I moved and had to start office dwelling. I ate fast food every day and slowly deteriorated. Tumor kicked that into overdrive and I was pretty much dying. Back to Grandma's diet and never looked back. I feel decent now.

1592525516623708160.a: Man, I hope Jay Leno recovers well. May his suffering serve as a reminder just how terrifyingly deadly gasoline is; ask anyone skilled in chemistry or explosives. You can outrun a lithium battery fire and go hide behind something. Gasoline will literally chase you.
